Claim only task rg9-plugin-greenfield-recipe-generation-closeout-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-0 through RG-8 are accepted. Latest accepted Plugin commit is 4af4f1fc7ac3c161b59319abe32dbf96a9983a63; latest accepted Core producer is a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. Controller precheck for RG-9 found lib/recipe-generation/ currently has only contracts.ts, index.ts, plan-generation-gate.ts, plan-tool.ts, and project-context-anchoring.ts; substantial recipe-generation code still lives under lib/runtime/mcp/host-agent-workflows, lib/runtime/evolution, lib/service/bootstrap, lib/service/evolution, lib/service/vector, and lib/service/project-knowledge-context. Goal: complete RG-9 green-field closeout so Recipe-generation-related Plugin code is coherently housed under lib/recipe-generation/ (or explicitly justified as MCP transport/DI/non-recipe-generation infrastructure), old paths/shims are removed or reduced to allowed thin re-export/transport boundaries, imports use #recipe-generation/* where appropriate, and the repository is ready for RG-10 BiliDili real-scenario validation. Required behavior: (1) Read AlembicPlugin/AGENTS.md plus parent AGENTS.md and this state root. Inspect the current dependency graph before moving files: package.json #recipe-generation alias, tsconfig/import rules, lib/recipe-generation/*, lib/runtime/mcp/host-agent-workflows/{cold-start,knowledge-rescan,dimension-completion,project-context-analysis,project-data-root,recipe-evidence-gate,knowledge-index-rebuild,recipe-region-vector}.ts, lib/runtime/evolution/PluginOpportunisticEvolution.ts, lib/runtime/mcp/host/opportunistic-evolution-presenter.ts, lib/service/{bootstrap,evolution,vector,project-knowledge-context}, lib/injection/modules/{InfraModule,VectorModule,KnowledgeModule}.ts, MCP handlers/tool-router/search/recipe-map/structure/kc tools, tests/imports, postbuild/clean-dist/release-boundary scripts if they hard-code old paths. (2) Execute the green-field migration leaf-first using the confirmed 8-slice plan as the guide, but adapt to the current post-RG8 reality: move leaf vector/data-root/region-vector/bootstrap event types first; then BootstrapEventEmitter/knowledge-index-rebuild; then project-context-analysis/recipe-evidence-gate; then cold-start/knowledge-rescan/dimension-completion with handler adapter re-exports if needed; then project-knowledge-context retrieval/tree; then PluginOpportunisticEvolution/FileChangeHandler/git-diff-checkpoint/presenter imports; then BootstrapTaskManager; then remove old paths/shims. If the full closeout is too broad for one turn, complete the largest safe connected leaf-first subset with green checks and return blocked/needs-review naming the exact remaining slices, but do not ship an unconnected rename shell. (3) Preserve runtime behavior and public MCP business semantics: MCP transport classes/HostMcpServer/McpServer/tools registration may stay in runtime/mcp with imports updated; host-agent handler files may remain thin transport adapters/re-exports only when needed; Core capabilities stay in @alembic/core; no daemon/watch/git-hook behavior; no Plan generation-state double-write; no evidence/proposal/vector deletion. (4) Eliminate old recipe-generation implementation ownership from lib/service and old runtime workflow folders where a replacement exists. Any compatibility re-export must name its current consumer, reason, removal condition, and owner in code or target result; do not keep compatibility layers without a consumer. (5) Update tests and imports mechanically but intentionally; keep existing behavior. Preserve RG4/RG5/RG6/RG7/RG8 functionality: confirmed Plan gates/testMode/moduleMining, ProjectContext creation anchoring, vector availability output, immediate freshness, and commit-driven unified evolution. (6) Add or update focused tests proving recipe-generation imports/entrypoints resolve from the new subsystem, old implementation paths are absent or thin adapters only, and a representative bootstrap/rescan/plan/evolution path still works. Boundary scans should prove no stale #service/* imports for moved recipe-generation internals except explicitly allowed DI/transport infrastructure. (7) Do not start RG-10 BiliDili/Test validation, Alembic main follow-on, broad Recipe quality evaluation, release packaging, or unrelated full-unit cleanup. Existing unrelated full-unit failures (search/prime/HostMcpServer/HitRecorder) may remain only if unchanged and outside moved/touched scope. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted moved-slice tests (RecipeGenerationSkeleton, PlanDrivenGenerationGate/AlembicPlanTool, HostAgentProjectContext/RecipeEvidenceGate, LocalEmbedding/RecipeRegionVectorAvailability, GitDiffCheckpoint/PluginOpportunisticEvolution/FileChangeHandler, project-knowledge-context/search/recipe-map tests touched by moves); import/old-path grep evidence; ./node_modules/.bin/biome check on touched files; npm run lint; npm run lint:core-import-boundary; npm run lint:repo-boundary; npm run lint:layer-boundary; npm run verify:release-package-boundary; git diff --check; Alembic Guard over changed files. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash(es), moved files map old->new, remaining allowed old adapters with consumer/removal condition, exact validation output, full-unit comparison if run, risks, and RG-10 eligibility note.
